name: Kalphite

variantInfo.name: Kalphite worker
notes: The weakest variant of kalphite.
Kalphite workers cannot poison, unlike soldiers and guardians.
Good choice when the player wants a quick cannon task.

variantInfo.name: Kalphite soldier
notes: A mid-level variant of kalphite.
Can induce poison beginning at 4 damage.
Recommended over guardians when the player wants better Slayer experience.

variantInfo.name: Kalphite guardian
notes: A high-level variant of kalphite.
Can induce poison beginning at 6 damage.
Generally not optimal because guardians are sparse, large, and have a worse cost/experience ratio than soldiers.

variantInfo.name: Kalphite Queen
notes: Queen of the kalphites and most powerful of its species.
Has two forms with different resistances and attacks with all three forms of combat.
For more information on fighting the Kalphite Queen, see Kalphite Queen/Strategies.

locationComparison.name: Kalphite Lair
notes: 13 Workers; 7 Soldiers; 4 Guardians; 1 Queen.
All variants are found here, including the Kalphite Queen.
Two of the kalphite guardians spawn on the first floor, and two on the second floor with the Kalphite Queen; these spawn slowly compared to Kalphite Cave.
A rope needs to be used to access the lair if the player has not completed the Hard Desert Diary.
A second rope is needed to access the Queen's lair.

locationComparison.name: Kalphite Cave
notes: 18 Workers; 20 Soldiers; 5 Guardians.
Slayer task-exclusive area containing the 3 normal varieties of kalphites.
Contains five open chambers: two worker chambers, two soldier chambers, and one guardian chamber.
Recommended for normal Kalphite tasks because the open chambers and many spawns significantly speed up completion.

taskNotes: Kalphites can be assigned as a Slayer task at 15 combat by all Slayer masters with the exception of Wilderness Slayer master Krystilia.
Kalphites are available from all non-Wilderness Slayer masters because they come in a wide variety of levels.
They can be found in the Kalphite Lair in the north-west Kharidian Desert and in the task-exclusive Kalphite Cave east of Shantay Pass.
Kalphites come in workers, soldiers, guardians, and the boss monster the Kalphite Queen.
With the exception of the Queen, all Kalphites use melee attacks.
Soldiers and guardians can induce poison starting at 4 and 6 Hitpoints damage respectively, and this poison bypasses protection prayers.
Protect from Melee and poison immunity completely negate damage from workers, soldiers, and guardians.
Normal Kalphite tasks should be done at the Kalphite Cave because it has five chambers with many Kalphites and faster completion times.
If Konar forces the task to the Kalphite Lair, soldiers should be cannoned for fast task progression.
Players who want a quick task should cannon workers.
Players looking for experience should cannon soldiers instead.
Guardians will generally never be optimal because they are sparse, larger, and have a worse cost/experience ratio than soldiers.
Killing the Kalphite Queen is not recommended unless the player is progressing the Elite Desert diary or has completed it and has 86 Agility.
Without the Hard Desert Diary, two ropes are likely needed for every Kalphite Queen trip.
The keris dagger from Contact! increases damage against all kalphites by 33% and has a 1/51 chance to deal a hit with tripled damage, but its low stats make it a poor regular-task choice.
The Keris partisan from Beneath Cursed Sands is stronger, more accurate, deals more damage, and has a crush option for Kalphite weakness.
The Keris partisan of breaching requires 80 Attack and adds an additional 33% accuracy against Kalphites, letting it outperform many expensive weapons for a fraction of the price.
recommendedMethod: Use the Kalphite Cave for normal tasks: cannon workers for the quickest completion or soldiers for better experience. Bring Protect from Melee, poison immunity, and a Keris partisan or Keris partisan of breaching when available.
